Petanque Pro.name: Petanque Pro
Petanque Pro.summary: Petanque Pro is a sports game on Wii. The title obviously plunges you into the world of pétanque. The menus give you access to 3 different game modes: Quick Game which, as its name suggests, allows you to challenge the A.I. or a friend in a basic game, Tournament mode and its three variants, and Custom Game mode.

Precure All Stars - Zenin Shuugou Let's.summary: Rhythm game including 12 popular songs and 32 characters from the first ten PreCure anime series.
